content: This will delete your {{count}} expert agents and arbiter, then start a new setup conversation. The setup wizard itself will be preserved. This cannot be undone.

comment.text: Warning message in a confirmation dialog body describing the consequences of resetting the arbiter and agents. The {{count}} variable represents the number of expert agents to be deleted.
